axes.concept: Operational: keep inputs and engine output visible together inside the existing Pictures working paper.
axes.layout: Persistent left tool sidebar (248px) beside one divided working paper: 0.85:1.35 input/result split; quote reverses to a wide line editor and narrow totals column; gallery is a thumbnail register with adjacent preview. Splits stack by container width, not viewport.
axes.navigation: Left sidebar (real shadcn Sidebar, static) lists only the account's tools — Herramientas home, then each tool, with Decoraciones nested under Taller 3D — and switches between them in place with aria-current; on phones it collapses behind a «Herramientas · <tool>» toggle. Method buttons switch form/phrase/photo in place; gallery rows select an inline preview.
axes.typography: Inherited Geist Sans, 24px H1, 18px sections, 13–15px controls and rows; 28px tabular count and quote totals. Geist Mono remains the inherited Sempertex treatment.
axes.density: Compact ruled rows and grouped 2-column fields, 24px panel gutters; no ornamental dashboard metrics. Phone stacks the same working groups with 20px gutters.
axes.components: Real shadcn Sidebar (SidebarProvider, Sidebar collapsible=none, SidebarMenu/Button/Sub), Button, Input, Textarea, Skeleton and Animate UI AlertDialog, recomposed into sidebar + one paper; native selects and the inherited account disclosure.
axes.colour: Exactly Pictures light/dark tokens and inherited accessible control-edge alias. Accent only for primary actions and focus; sidebar current item is a neutral superficie-2 step with weight, no coloured bar.
axes.motion: Precise cuts: paper enters 5px vertically, sidebar items and rows enter 8px horizontally with 35ms stagger, the neutral current-tool marker slides between sidebar items (shared layout), results arrive from the opposite edge, preview seats at .985 scale. 280ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), repeated actions 150ms; natural/subtle scale down; reduced motion removes travel and transitions.
